logline: 학교를 마치고도 갈 자리가 없는 남자가, 아들에게는 다른 길을 주려다 같은 문 앞에 선다.
destination: 인쇄소 문 앞 — 그가 아들의 손을 놓게 되는 자리
protagonist: 일자리를 구하지 못한 삼십 대 지식인
setting: 1930년대 경성의 신문사 앞 거리와 하숙방, 인쇄소 골목
anchor: a thin man in a worn western suit and round glasses, frayed cuffs
palette: sooty grey, tram-line steel, weak winter sun, dull ochre brick

beats.beat: 양복 입은 남자가 아침부터 구두를 닦는다.
beats.visual: a thin man in a worn suit having his shoes brushed at a street stand, tram rails behind him
beats.motion: the brush works fast, a tram slides past behind, his hands stay folded

beats.beat: 그는 신문사 문을 나서며 헛기침을 한다.
beats.visual: a thin man stepping out of a brick office doorway onto a busy street, hand at his collar
beats.motion: the door falls shut behind him, his collar tugs, crowds stream past

beats.beat: 하숙비가 밀려 주인이 방문 앞에 선다.
beats.visual: an older woman standing in a narrow corridor outside a closed paper door, arms crossed
beats.motion: her foot taps the boards, the door stays shut, corridor light dims

beats.visual: three men leaning over a low table of small cups in a cramped tavern, smoke thick above them
beats.motion: cups clink and tip, smoke coils upward, one man's hand slaps the table

beats.visual: a thin man standing still in a doorway holding a folded slip, station steam beyond the alley
beats.motion: his fingers close on the paper, steam drifts down the alley, his shoulders drop

beats.beat: 그는 아홉 살 아들의 손을 잡고 거리를 걷는다.
beats.visual: a thin man walking a small boy by the hand along a wide grey street, shop awnings above
beats.motion: their joined hands swing once, the boy skips a step, dust lifts off the road

beats.visual: a small boy's shoulder framed in a workshop doorway, a man's hand hovering behind him, dark interior
beats.motion: the hand hovers and withdraws, machinery shudders inside, light narrows

beats.beat: 인쇄소 문이 닫히고 거리에 먼지가 인다.
beats.visual: a workshop door swinging shut on a grey street, dust lifting in the road, tram rails empty
beats.motion: the door closes, dust rolls down the street, a tram wire hums

withheld: 아들을 맡기고 돌아서며 스스로를 비웃는 마지막 대목
